name: Choosen - Dating Application
source:
You play as Lucas, a discreet young man about his sexuality. Encouraged by his best friend, he installs a dating app. 

Will he be able to open up and finally meet someone ?

[From [url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/choosen-dating-application]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演卢卡斯，一个对自己的性取向持谨慎态度的年轻人。在他最好的朋友的鼓励下，他安装了一款约会应用程序。

他能敞开心扉并最终遇见某人吗？

[来自[url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/choosen-dating-application]Itch.io[/url]]
